text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Developers write unit tests to check small parts of code, such as a single function. Integration tests then make sure different parts work together correctly. Many teams also use test-driven development, where they write tests before the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Although writing tests takes time, it brings real benefits. Tests catch mistakes early, so problems are easier and cheaper to fix. Most importantly, good tests give developers confidence. They can change or improve the code without fear, because the tests will quickly tell them if something breaks.
